mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.ticket_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.username, ''), u.phone) AS author_name, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_by, c.update_by, c.deleted FROM ticket_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.ticket_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.username, ''), u.phone) AS author_name, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_by, c.update_by, c.deleted FROM ticket_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND c.deleted = 0
AND c.comment_type != 'INTERNAL'
ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_comment SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
